description:
Convert a Red/Green composite microscopy image into a colorblind-accessible Magenta/Green figure.

1. Open the file `~/Fiji_Data/raw/composite/unsafe_composite.tif`. This is a 2-channel composite where Channel 1 is Red and Channel 2 is Green.
2. Change the color of Channel 1 to **Magenta** (keep Channel 2 as Green).
3. Convert the composite to a flattened RGB image (`Image > Type > RGB Color`).
4. Save the result as `~/Fiji_Data/results/figures/accessible_composite.png`.
5. Verify the accessibility by running a Deuteranopia simulation (`Image > Color > Simulate Color Blindness`).
6. Save the simulation proof as `~/Fiji_Data/results/figures/deuteranopia_proof.png`.
